sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Only 1 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Firing this flare into the sky will call in a special airdrop containing PC components and military electronics, as well as illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition
- (Unavailable on Ground Zero, Factory, The Lab, The Labyrinth, Terminal, Icebreaker)

- The flare is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as initial equipment for Half-Empty
